description: Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules — AI Governance Violations

rules.name: AI — Unauthorized Model Deployment
rules.description: Detects deployment of AI models without proper approval or governance review
rules.query:
model_deployment_events
| where approval_status == "none" or governance_review == false
| summarize count() by ModelName, DeployedBy, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Bias Detection Alert
rules.description: Detects AI model outputs exhibiting statistical bias across protected demographic groups
rules.query:
model_output_events
| where bias_score > 0.3 and protected_group != ""
| summarize avg(bias_score), count() by ModelName, ProtectedGroup, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where avg_bias_score > 0.3 and count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Missing Model Documentation
rules.description: Detects AI models operating without required documentation including model cards and impact assessments
rules.query:
model_registry_events
| where documentation_status == "missing" or model_card == false or impact_assessment == false
| summarize count() by ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Decision Without Human Oversight
rules.description: Detects high-stakes AI decisions made without required human oversight or review
rules.query:
ai_decision_events
| where risk_level in ("high", "critical") and human_review == false and human_in_loop_required == true
| summarize count() by DecisionType, ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Regulatory Compliance Violation
rules.description: Detects AI operations that violate regulatory requirements including EU AI Act, GDPR, and industry standards
rules.query:
ai_compliance_events
| where compliance_status == "violation" and regulation in ("EU-AI-Act", "GDPR", "PCI-DSS", "HIPAA")
| summarize count() by Regulation, ViolationType, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Explainability Requirement Violation
rules.description: Detects AI decisions that lack required explainability or interpretability documentation
rules.query:
ai_decision_events
| where explainability_required == true and explanation_provided == false
| summarize count() by DecisionType, ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Consent and Privacy Violation
rules.description: Detects AI processing of personal data without proper consent or lawful basis
rules.query:
ai_data_processing_events
| where data_category in ("personal", "sensitive", "special-category") and consent_status == "missing"
| summarize count() by DataCategory, ProcessingPurpose, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Model Version Drift Detection
rules.description: Detects AI model performance drift beyond acceptable thresholds requiring governance review
rules.query:
model_performance_events
| where performance_drift_pct > 10 and baseline_accuracy > 0.9
| summarize avg(performance_drift_pct), count() by ModelName, ModelVersion, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where avg_performance_drift_pct > 10

rules.name: AI — Prohibited Use Detection
rules.description: Detects AI systems used for prohibited purposes under EU AI Act including social scoring and manipulative techniques
rules.query:
ai_usage_events
| where use_case in ("social_scoring", "manipulation", "exploitation", "subliminal", "real_time_biometric") and prohibited == true
| summarize count() by UseCase, ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Audit Trail Gap Detection
rules.description: Detects gaps in AI system audit trails that violate governance record-keeping requirements
rules.query:
ai_audit_events
| where audit_trail_complete == false and audit_required == true
| summarize count() by SystemName, AuditGapType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Data Minimization Violation
rules.description: Detects AI systems collecting or processing more data than necessary for their stated purpose
rules.query:
ai_data_collection_events
| where data_fields_processed > required_fields * 2 and purpose_limitation_violation == true
| summarize count() by ModelName, Purpose, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — High-Risk System Without Assessment
rules.description: Detects high-risk AI systems operating without mandatory risk assessments
rules.query:
ai_system_events
| where risk_category in ("high", "prohibited") and risk_assessment_complete == false
| summarize count() by SystemName, RiskCategory, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Retention Policy Violation
rules.description: Detects AI data retention beyond policy-defined periods violating data governance requirements
rules.query:
ai_data_retention_events
| where data_age > retention_policy_days and data_deleted == false
| summarize count() by DataCategory, RetentionPolicyDays, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 10

rules.name: AI — Third-Party Model Risk Assessment Missing
rules.description: Detects third-party AI models used without required risk assessments or due diligence
rules.query:
model_deployment_events
| where model_source == "third-party" and risk_assessment == "none" and due_diligence == false
| summarize count() by ModelName, VendorName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Transparency Requirement Violation
rules.description: Detects AI interactions where users are not informed they are interacting with an AI system
rules.query:
ai_interaction_events
| where transparency_disclosure == false and user_facing == true and disclosure_required == true
| summarize count() by SystemName, InteractionType, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Automated Decision Without Appeal Mechanism
rules.description: Detects automated AI decisions that lack required human appeal or contestation mechanisms
rules.query:
ai_decision_events
| where decision_type == "automated" and appeal_mechanism == false and appeal_required == true
| summarize count() by DecisionType, ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Monitoring and Logging Gap
rules.description: Detects gaps in AI system monitoring and logging required by governance frameworks
rules.query:
ai_system_events
| where monitoring_enabled == false or logging_enabled == false or logging_gap_detected == true
| summarize count() by SystemName, GapType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: AI — Cross-Border Data Transfer Violation
rules.description: Detects AI processing of personal data involving cross-border transfers without adequate safeguards
rules.query:
ai_data_transfer_events
| where transfer_type == "cross_border" and safeguard_mechanism == "none" and data_category in ("personal", "sensitive")
| summarize count() by SourceRegion, DestinationRegion, SafeguardMechanism, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Incident Response Plan Violation
rules.description: Detects AI incidents that trigger response procedures without documented incident response plans
rules.query:
ai_incident_events
| where incident_type in ("safety", "bias", "privacy", "security") and response_plan_exists == false
| summarize count() by IncidentType, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Children's Data Protection Violation
rules.description: Detects AI systems processing children's data without required parental consent or age verification
rules.query:
ai_data_processing_events
| where data_subject_age < 16 and parental_consent == false and age_verification == false
| summarize count() by SystemName, DataCategory, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Model Performance Degradation Alert
rules.description: Detects significant AI model performance degradation that requires governance review
rules.query:
model_performance_events
| where accuracy_degradation_pct > 15 or latency_increase_pct > 50
| summarize avg(accuracy_degradation_pct), avg(latency_increase_pct), count() by ModelName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where avg_accuracy_degradation_pct > 15 or avg_latency_increase_pct > 50

rules.name: AI — Unauthorized Data Processing Purpose
rules.description: Detects AI data processing for purposes beyond what was consented to or documented
rules.query:
ai_data_processing_events
| where processing_purpose != consented_purpose and purpose_limitation_enforced == false
| summarize count() by ProcessingPurpose, ConsentedPurpose, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Right to Explanation Violation
rules.description: Detects AI decisions where data subjects are denied the right to an explanation of the decision logic
rules.query:
ai_explanation_requests
| where explanation_provided == false and explanation_required == true
| summarize count() by SystemName, RequestType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: AI — Safety Override Without Authorization
rules.description: Detects safety override or bypass of AI safety controls without proper authorization
rules.query:
ai_safety_events
| where safety_override == true and authorized_override == false
| summarize count() by SystemName, OverrideType, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: AI — Data Subject Rights Request Violation
rules.description: Detects failures to respond to data subject rights requests within required timeframes
rules.query:
data_subject_request_events
| where request_type in ("access", "deletion", "portability", "rectification") and response_time_days > 30 and request_status != "completed"
| summarize count() by RequestType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where count_ > 3
